role: Working-session detail with goal, three timed steps and outcome
takeaway: Author supplies a content-specific takeaway when adapting this source layout.

slot_notes.coverage: Native text in all selected content objects, including table cells and grouped objects where bindings exist.
slot_notes.rich_runs: Arrays preserve source run boundaries and typography.
slot_notes.source_values: Original words retained, including source facts and existing spelling.

style_notes: Source fonts, colors and geometry retained by default.
Named color profiles only affect individually mapped decorative objects.
opaque_areas: Images, embedded charts/think-cell/OLE data and master/layout artwork remain original resources. Their pixels or data are not changed by text slots.
retained_source_content: Original customer/staff names, testimonials, metrics, photos and claims remain source material, not approved claims for a new deck.
Footer, legal text and page number remain original.
limitations: Retains think-cell metadata as an opaque resource. Count is three steps; timing and goal text are editable.
Slot arrays preserve source rich-run cardinality and existing tab/line-break sequence.
No automatic reflow, item-count changes, image replacement, or arbitrary content fit qualification.
